description: Defines the AddressMap template class for managing address-based object retrieval, including methods for storing, retrieving, and clearing address entries. Part of the Google Breakpad project, specifically related to address mapping functionality.

classes.name: AddressMap
classes.description: Template class providing address-based storage and retrieval of entries, with methods Store, Retrieve, and Clear.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Inserts an entry into the address map at a specified address, returns false if an entry already exists at that address.

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the entry at the highest address less than or equal to the given address; returns false if none found.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the address map to its initial empty state.
